items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Blue was one of the baddest hoodlums that ever lived.

ctx.x: Steele(?) had him called Big Brother. Even the racketeers, like Bob Ewing and them...Blue and all of them, he said, "Hey, big brother." He'd call him and give himself protection gettin' in with them hoodlums. That's my big brother. "How you doin, big brother?" "Talkin' to Blue." Blue was one of the baddest hoodlums that ever lived. He'd say, "Hey, Blue, Mister Blue, how you doin', Blue." He'd get with everybody. Everybody. "Hello, Brother, Cousin, Bub." He'd give you a name so he would remember." Where did this…

So everywhere Paul went... So they called me "Little Peewee" or "Little Barbarin." Most of the musicians when I first went there called "Little Barbarin." So I meet Steele(?). Paul would say, "Steele(?), look out for him, because he's just come from down there. He don't know much. He thinks he knows, you know." Steele(?) said, "I'll pull his coat." So Steele(?) would tell me everything...always... I've never forgotten. He always kept explaining me things until I left New York.
